description: From-the-Lagrangian derivation of the alpha_EM correction 2/(3pi) (prop:em-coupling-bring-zero-mode open Status item).  The photon IR zero-mode is the harmonic 1-form sector on the 2-surface M_Bring, b_1(M_g)=2g, normalised by the Gauss-Bonnet area Area=-2pi*chi=4pi(g-1): shift = b_1/Area = 2g/(4pi(g-1)) = 2/(3pi) at g=4.  The recorded failed naive attempt used the 3-manifold M x S^1 (b_1=2g+1, Vol=Area*2pi), giving 9/(24pi^2) ~5.6x smaller; the surface-minus-naive difference (16pi-9)/(24pi^2)>0 (Lean surface_minus_naive_g4).  The topological/geometric core (b_1=2g, Gauss-Bonnet, the ratio, the difference) is proven sorry-free in Lean QOU.Archimedean.PhotonIRZeroMode; the heat-kernel zero-mode=b_1/Vol is the standard cited input.  Nothing fitted.

data.finding: The photon IR zero-mode of the alpha_EM correction is the harmonic 1-form sector on the 2-surface M_Bring (b_1=2g) over its Gauss-Bonnet area (4pi(g-1)), = 2/(3pi) at g=4 — resolving the open from-the-Lagrangian Status item.  The naive M x S^1 (3-manifold) attempt fails because it adds a spurious S^1 generator and 2pi of volume.  The '/3' is (g-1)=3 (Gauss-Bonnet), not a round-ball dimension.  Core proven sorry-free in Lean; heat-kernel zero-mode=b_1/Vol cited; upstream tau_arch uniqueness remains the named conditional input.
